s.how: Cut 120g vintage cheddar, 120g gouda and 120g Swiss cheese into rough chunks on a dark wooden board. Add 1 pack rye crispbread, a jar of pickled onions and a pot of grainy mustard. Leave out 20 minutes before serving so the cheese softens.

Wrap 2 beetroots in foil and roast at 200C for 1 hour, then peel. Blitz with a drained 400g tin chickpeas, 3 tbsp tahini, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and 3 tbsp water until smooth. Swirl into a bowl and serve with 150g crackers.

m.note: a hearty dinner in the castle
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 3 sliced brown onions slowly for 20 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp sweet paprika and 1 tsp caraway seeds, then add 400g crushed tomatoes, 300ml beef stock and the beef. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve over 400g buttered egg noodles with 150g sour cream.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 170g self-raising flour, 30g cocoa and 100ml milk. Bake in 12 cases at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat 150g butter, 250g icing sugar and 30g cocoa and pipe a tall swirl on each. Melt 100g white chocolate into 12 thin discs, set, and sit one under each swirl as a hat brim.

d.note: Frau Blücher offers brandy, then warm milk, before bed
d.how: Warm 800ml full cream milk with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract until steaming, without boiling. Rest 5 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Whisk hard until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, add 30ml brandy to each and grate over a little nutmeg. Leave out the brandy for the warm milk crowd.
